title: Dusk's GearChant
description: a simple plugin to allow you easily upgrade your weapon using your xp anytime and anywhere.
body:
# Enchanting
you can enchant your weapon as simple as typing in a command

```
/gearchant
```
# Anytime , Anywhere
there is no need for grinding for leather to make bookshelf and you dont have to calculate 16893 math problems and break 7 anvils to enchant your helmet

simply open the menu and select your enchant
# Server-Side
this is entirely server-side and clients can join vanilla or moded

# Upgrading
wanna upgrade your protection IV to V Huh? instead of hammering 16 books togather you can open the menu and BAM! done you upgraded your enchantment

_pssst : it also breaks the vanilla enchant limit and bypasses the incompatibilities_

# Balanced Cost
well it was all benefits till here now its time for the deal with the dev.... ummm i mean the developer yes a deal with the developer

### xp costs ramp up each upgraded level
